subject.title: RFC addendum: hosted feed trust verification series

question: Should this PR merge as the combined hosted-feed trust-verification, ClawHub account-feed/following, and platform feed-signing roadmap, and should RFC 0009 metadata change before merge?
rationale: The patch is mostly documentation-clean, but it defines security and product roadmap direction while the RFC remains draft, so automation cannot safely decide acceptance or scope.

options.title: Hold For RFC Acceptance
options.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers confirm the combined scope and intended RFC lifecycle state before merge.

options.title: Accept And Update Metadata
options.body: If maintainers accept the full direction, update RFC 0009 status and issue metadata according to README.md before merge.

options.title: Narrow Or Split Scope
options.body: If account feeds and following need separate review, trim this addendum to trust verification and move the ClawHub product track to a separate RFC or follow-up.

recommendation.title: Hold For RFC Acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until maintainers confirm the combined scope and intended RFC lifecycle state before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest feature-history context across RFC 0009, the merged telemetry addendum, and this trust-verification branch.
